text: Cloudflare shipped a breaking change in 12 of the last 12 months.
The single roughest month on record: Stripe in May 2018, with 223 breaking changes across 191 endpoints.
Twilio hasn't shipped a breaking change in 12 months.
Cloudflare made 1,355 "soft" changes in a year: new enum values and response types that strict clients can trip on.
Cloudflare leads 2026 with 535 breaking changes so far.
